feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED. The candidate defines exactly one predicate per declared proposition (at_exit, box_fell, holding_box) and none for propositions the machine does not use; names match the identifiers and each function takes exactly env. All bodies are single-expression returns with no assignments, conditionals, loops, imports, or sibling-predicate calls, and only documented API surfaces are used (env.grid.get, env.agent_pos, env.carrying, env.carrying.type, env.events_this_step). Missing values are guarded before attribute reads: at_exit checks the cell is not None before reading .type, and holding_box checks env.carrying is not None before reading .type. The persistent predicates at_exit and holding_box read only the current observation. The event predicate box_fell is sourced from env.events_this_step, which the documented API explicitly designates for event propositions ('fall' marks the step on which the box left the agent's hands), and it cannot be true on the first step since a fall requires an earlier pickup. No mutation of env or env.episode_memory, no .get on the previous valuation, and no recursive history.
